libs.note: BH-5649 (BH-5633.1): the fleet registry read path. With REGISTRY_SOURCE=db, bin/fleet-conf.sh and bin/render-cron.sh read harness-jobs GET /api/registry first, then the last good cache under state/registry/, then the committed fleet.conf and lanes.d. bin/box-for.sh and cron_watchdog_name_for read through fleet-conf.sh, so they follow. The default file reads only the committed files and never sources this lib. The D1 tables are seeded by bin/registry-seed.sh. These knobs are read from the environment of the calling process, not from settings rows: fleet-conf.sh must not make an HTTP call to learn whether to make one.

knobs.note: file or db. Any other value reads as file. Read as ${REGISTRY_SOURCE:-file} in bin/fleet-conf.sh and bin/render-cron.sh; the code default stays file. BH-5651: bin/harness-sync.sh appends REGISTRY_SOURCE=db to env/global.env once, when that file has no REGISTRY_SOURCE= line and GET /api/registry answers with the checkout fleet.conf project set. An operator line REGISTRY_SOURCE=file in env/global.env is the kill switch and is never overwritten.

How old state/registry/fleet.conf may be before db mode asks GET /api/registry again. A younger cache answers with no HTTP call. An outage serves the cache at any age. Read as ${REGISTRY_CACHE_TTL_S:-60}. Set it in env/global.env.
The curl timeout of one GET /api/registry. There is no retry: a failure serves the cache. Read as ${REGISTRY_API_TIMEOUT_S:-5}. Set it in env/global.env.
